title: Inclusion-normalized logarithmic image-ideal predicates
statement: Let X be a scheme and M a log structure with structural map alpha, with log ideal family I [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, def-trf-fine-log-etale-descent-datum]. For an étale object W, define imageIdealSections to be those regular functions whose every geometric germ lies in the ring ideal generated by alpha of the log ideal stalk, using [def-trf-log-regular-pair]. For ideal sheaf data K, define logIdealTensorInclusion to be the tensor pullback of its inclusion composed with the canonical structure-module comparison [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sfb-tensor-pullback-structure-sheaf-map]. IsImageIdealAlgebraization means that this map is mono and its top-section range equals imageIdealSections on every W. For an affine étale chart with finite E in a monoid P, logImageChartIdeal is the ring ideal generated by the images of E through alpha and the canonical global-sections isomorphism, and logImageTildeInclusion is tilde of its subtype map followed by tildeSelf [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections, def-trf-log-ideal-chart-presentation]. HasImageIdealChartFormula means there is a unique isomorphism from the pulled-back ideal to this tilde ideal respecting those inclusions whenever P is finitely generated integral, the chart is a chart of M, E is nonempty and E generates I on geometric stalks. HasCanonicalEtaleIdealDescent means any labelled family equal to restrictions of K has unique inclusion-preserving overlap isomorphisms on all étale test objects, with diagonal identity, triple cocycle, and realization by restriction of K. These are the existing predicates, relocated without changing their bodies or signatures.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: generic quasicoherent finite-presentation predicates and constructors, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_map, ideal_map_of_isAffineHom and ideal_mono. None concerns log structures, structural-image algebraization or its chart and strict etale compatibility.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: IdealSheafData.glueDataObj, ofIdeals, ext_of_isAffine, mk.inj, subschemeCover, ofIdealTop_ideal, specTargetImage, ext_of_iSup_eq_top. These provide generic ideal constructors or extensionality, not logarithmic image algebraization, its chart formula or strict étale compatibility.
Twelve hits: Scheme.IdealSheafData and its addition, multiplication, lattice and radical instances. No logarithmic image-ideal existence, chart comparison or strict étale compatibility.

Twenty-five hits in Mathlib: ordinary ideal tensor and flatness lemmas, including Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_injective and Ideal.subtype_rTensor_range; no logIdeal definitions or logarithmic image-ideal results.
